topic: SGLT2 inhibitor heart failure mortality older adults
criteria: randomized controlled trials, 2020 onwards, human, older adults with heart failure

source_review.title: The role of sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitors in frail older adults with or without type 2 diabetes mellitus

conclusion_summary: SGLT2 inhibitors demonstrate significant reduction in heart failure hospitalization and cardiovascular mortality across HFrEF and HFpEF populations.
limitations: Limited data in very old (>85) adults
